items.title: Mass-standardised quantitative biophotonic assay for profiling the SARS-CoV-2 spike IgG response in recovery and vaccination cohorts

Mass-Standardised Differential Antibody Binding to a Spectrum of SARS-CoV-2 Variant Spike Proteins: Wuhan, Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Delta, Omicron BA.1, BA.4/5, BA.2.75 and BA.2.12.1 Variants-Antibody Immunity Endotypes
Real-world evaluation of a novel technology for quantitative simultaneous antibody detection against multiple SARS-CoV-2 antigens in a cohort of patients presenting with COVID-19 syndrome
